verdict.rationale: NRQL is described as a SQL-like ad-hoc query language over New Relic's event data that can filter logs/attributes and build charts, implying schema-flexible querying, but no evidence explicitly addresses high-cardinality fields (user id, request id), FACET/GROUP BY on arbitrary attributes, or the absence of pre-aggregation/index requirements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of high-cardinality grouping/filtering, confirmation that no indexing/schema definition is needed, and independent benchmarks or user reports validating this at scale.
